evals.prompt: I uploaded a resume and notes with two conflicting dates. Build the private fact bank, ask only the missing clarification, and do not draft unsupported bullets.
evals.expected_output: A facts-pending result with source evidence, one targeted clarification, and no invented date.

evals.prompt: Tailor this resume for an AI solutions role. Keep two accomplishment blocks under Mitsubishi UFJ Information Technology: Salesforce Agentforce deployment with three nested bullets, and ICLR 2026 conference representation with one nested bullet. Use one banking customer term, spell out the employer name, and put the mobile product last.
evals.expected_output: A one-page ATS-safe draft and report with the two-block hierarchy, nested evidence-backed bullets, canonical terminology, no MUIT abbreviation in the resume, and the mobile product last.

evals.prompt: The baseline resume was explicitly approved yesterday. Process today's eligible roles without asking me to review the same resume again, but stop on a new factual conflict and report it.
evals.expected_output: Autonomous refinement for eligible roles, durable hashes/reports, and a blocker only for genuinely new conflicting facts.

evals.prompt: Refine an English and Japanese resume for a candidate who studied at Keio University from April 2020 to April 2024, studied/researched at Nara Institute of Science and Technology from April 2024 to April 2026, and concurrently conducted research at Advanced Telecommunications Research Institute International. Use official institution names, keep education and research as separate entries, and apply region-appropriate date rules without inventing a degree conferral.
evals.expected_output: English and Japanese variants with separate Education and Research sections, full institution names, explicit chronology where overlap matters, Japanese attendance periods, and no acronym-only headings or unsupported degree claims.
